infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: DITSALA uses Face ID to unlock the app quickly on this trusted device.

plugins.cameraPermission: DITSALA needs camera access to verify your identity, capture your ID document, and scan Circle QR codes — captures are never taken from your photo library.
plugins.microphonePermission: DITSALA needs microphone access for voice and video calls.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: DITSALA only accesses your location when you explicitly share it with a trusted Circle contact, or trigger SOS.

plugins.photosPermission: DITSALA needs access to your photos to set a profile picture.

plugins.contactsPermission: DITSALA checks which of your contacts already have an account, so you can add them to your Circle — your contact list is never uploaded or stored, only phone numbers are checked against DITSALA's own accounts.
